carmen_docs: Heads-up: while updating the Rate Limits & Billing doc I ran into multiple small things that should land in one coordinated PR so customers see a single migration path.
lucas_eng: list them out and we'll split the work.
carmen_docs: 1) error payload examples still only show `retry_after` (seconds). The runtime now emits `retry_after_ms` too. We should show both fields and recommend using `retry_after_ms` where available.
kia_support: Support sees a few customers that treated ms as s and over-slept. A short snippet for clients would help.
ben_sdk: I can add tiny SDK snippets for JS, Python, and Go showing the ms-first fallback. Draft JS:```js
// prefer retry_after_ms (ms), fallback to retry_after (s)
const body = await resp.json();
const waitMs = body.retry_after_ms ?? (body.retry_after ? body.retry_after * 1000 : null);
if (waitMs) await sleep(waitMs);
```
ben_sdk: Draft Go snippet:```go
// prefer retry_after_ms, fallback to retry_after
var body map[string]interface{}
decoder := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
decoder.Decode(&body)
var waitMs float64
if v, ok := body["retry_after_ms"].(float64); ok { waitMs = v }
else if v, ok := body["retry_after"].(float64); ok { waitMs = v * 1000 }
if waitMs > 0 { time.Sleep(time.Duration(waitMs) * time.Millisecond) }
```
carmen_docs: 2) quota & billing wording is inconsistent: some pages say "tokens", others say "billing units". Add a short conversion table and a migration note for existing customers that were billed under the old meter.
lucas_eng: I can draft the conversion table: "Generation: 1 token = 1 unit; Embeddings: 1K vectors = 1 unit" (will verify exact rates).
carmen_docs: 3) dashboard links/screenshots are stale. The canonical console path is https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers and teams need the Billing Viewer role to see per-tier consumption. Replace screenshots with annotated SVGs where possible (smaller diff).
ia-ci-bot: Link-checker: flagged internal redirect for /usage/tiers -> update to canonical path.
ben_sdk: also propose adding an SDK example showing how to parse the `x-burst-remaining` header so apps can surface burst capacity to users:```js
const r = await client.generate(...)
console.log('x-burst-remaining', r.headers['x-burst-remaining'])
```
kia_support: please add a short note about headers being present on both streaming and non-streaming responses. Support likes explicit examples.
carmen_docs: Plan: open a single PR with three commits: (A) error payload update + SDK snippets + snippet-tests, (B) billing wording + conversion table + migration note, (C) link fixes + screenshot replacements. PR description will include follow-ups for infra: expose `burst_used` metric to dashboard and add `requests_per_tier` chart.
lucas_eng: sounds good. Who will open PR and add reviewers?
ben_sdk: I'll open it and add @carmen_docs and @kia_support as reviewers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/981 (WIP)
carmen_docs: please add a short changelog blurb and a support KB update step in the PR checklist.
ben_sdk: will do. CI: I'll add snippet-tests under docs/tests/snippets to make sure examples run in the CI image.
docs-bot: CI: ensure snippet-tests include required imports and pass markdown-lint for long lines in code blocks.
kia_support: once merged we'll update the support KB and send a short note to enterprise customers about the `retry_after_ms` change.
lucas_eng: review incoming, will check conversion rates and the Go snippet.
ben_sdk: marking PR as ready for review, requesting review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
carmen_docs: thanks all, closing the loop here.
